summary.text: Tim Kaine is a U.S. Senator from Virginia, sworn in on January 3, 2013; he was born in 1958 and his hometown is Richmond.

paragraphs.text: He was elected to the Richmond City Council in 1994, became Mayor of Richmond in 1998, Lieutenant Governor of Virginia in 2002, and Governor in 2006, and chaired the Democratic National Committee from 2009 to 2011.
He graduated from the University of Missouri and Harvard Law School, and practiced law in Richmond for 17 years.
